title: Toddler on Spring Rocking Horse by Christmas Tree, 1957 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A classic 1950s home snapshot depicting a young toddler in one-piece footed pajamas riding a spring-mounted rocking horse indoors on Christmas morning. To the right, a decorated Christmas tree is adorned with dangling tinsel icicles and ornaments, with wrapped holiday gift boxes placed nearby on the floor and furniture. The top white deckled border displays a printed '57' stamp, reflecting post-war American holiday traditions and family life.
